items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And EARVELL SHAW says the same thing you know and all.

ctx.x: Yes that's when he sang that 'Black and Blue' and all that stuff.

But personally there was a little jealousy in those days with Louis. And that's what Barney (Bonnie?) says all the time, Louis was jealous you know. And Pop Foster says the same thing. And EARVELL SHAW says the same thing you know and all. But the show girls, the dancing girls, the acts the hits, they loved Zuddy so, you know. They wanted, they hadn't had anybody they said to play like that for them. And I think that made Louis feel like Zuddy was ...........
Oh, you mean he was very popular with the people in the show?
